preferences.name: showPreviews
preferences.title: Filter Previews
preferences.label: Generate Filter Previews
preferences.description: Whether to show live previews of filters for selected files. Disabling this option might improve performance.

preferences.name: hiddenFilters
preferences.title: Hidden Filters
preferences.description: Filters and filter categories to hide from the filter list. Separate multiple filters with commas. For example: 'Bloom, Distortion, Tonal'

preferences.name: generatePreviews
preferences.title: Image Previews
preferences.label: Generate Image Previews
preferences.description: Whether to generate previews of images upon every use of the command. If disabled, the command will run faster, but the previews won't match the colors of the generated image.

preferences.name: defaultBgColor
preferences.title: Default Replacement Color
preferences.description: The color to replace backgrounds with, in hex (e.g. #FF0000 or FF0000FF) or by name (e.g. red). Leave blank to make the background transparent. Used when the 'Replacement Color' argument is empty.

preferences.name: cropByDefault
preferences.title: Crop
preferences.label: Crop By Default
preferences.description: Crop images to the subject when the 'Crop To Subject' argument is not given.

preferences.name: preserveFormat
preferences.title: Format
preferences.label: Preserve Image Format
preferences.description: Keep the original image format. When disabled, the result is saved as a PNG image.
